title: This tool is the future of work for businesses #shorts
description:
This might be the most slept on tool in the world right now.

It’s called Genspark.

And if you’ve never tried this before, it’s pretty wild.

Genspark is one of the first true AI agent platforms.

And that means, in layman’s terms, it can actually do work for you.

If you’re a business owner, here’s a real use case we ran on Genspark to show you how far you can push these agentic workflows.

We told it we run a landscaping company in a specific suburb New Jersey and needed help getting more leads.

The first thing it did was canvas for all competitors in our area to figure out how the best ones were marketing.

It searched the internet, crawled the competitor websites, and built this marketing matrix.

By the way, it’s doing all this on its own using Genspark’s new Claw feature. 

The strategy, the action…I’m not telling it what to do, I’m just guiding it with details if it needs it.

Now the Claw determined that no landscaping company in our area had a social presence and that we should own digital with social content.

Naturally, now we need videos.

So we just asked it to create 2 timelapse landscaping videos using Seedance with corresponding landing pages for those videos.

Oh and we also asked for 10 static facebook ads to experiment with.

It generated the creative, made the landing pages, and made the ads…asking us for guidance along the way, but proactively solving problems as they came up.


Now the reason this worked so well is because the Claw feature has 30 preloaded skills, so it can access the internet, send messages, answer phone calls, make videos, all out of the box, depending on what it needs.

It’s their version of Openclaw, but runs in a sandboxed cloud, so there’s way less technical setup and an extra security layer.

So you can start to realize where this goes.

These agentic flows are the future of work.

Once you see this in action, for a use case you actually care about, there is no going back.

And this is just one of their new agentic releases.

They also just came out with Microsoft Excel and Powerpoint agent integrations so you use AI directly in those applications as well.

I’m not gonna lie, I was pretty blown away by how broad these capabilities ranged, and we were just scratching the service.

If you want to give Genspark a try, comment “Claw” and I’ll send you a full PDF breaking down our entire workflow as well as a bunch of free credits for their platform.
